subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: The harness shall run headless from a clean checkout with no agent, interactive-session, or factory-metadata dependency, producing its exit code, verdict artifact, and structured run log as its sole outputs.
rationale: portability by construction — the identical artifact is the future remote gate
fit_criterion: the advisory CI dry-run: on the same commit, the GitHub Actions invocation and the local invocation produce rung-for-rung identical verdicts (M4)
